simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to לַיִשׁ (H3918) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: לַיִשׁ (layish) means a lion (from his destructive blows ) First listed occurrence: Isa 30 6.

definitions.full: H3918. layish I. לַ֫יִשׁ noun masculine Job 4:11 lion (Arabic , לֵיתָא ᵑ7 ; Assyrian nešu , lion is compare by Hal (compare Hpt KAT 2, 510 ) Ba ZA iii. 1888, 60 ); — lion 4:11 ; Isa 30:6 (|| לָבִיא ), בַּבְּהֵמָה ׳ל גִּבֹּור Prov 30:30 .
